category_title: Middle school student with autism and language impairment exhibiting property destruction and self-injury when frustrated
scenario_title: Multi-step measurement task in math class
minimal_context: Carrie is working on a three-step measurement task during a math class in a general education setting.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Carrie, it is time for math. First, take your ruler, then measure the length of this poster, and finally write the number down on your paper.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Looks confused and stares at the ruler without picking it up)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: How are you going to start?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Makes an unintelligible sound and begins engaging in self-stimulation by rocking back and forth in her chair)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just go ahead and do the three steps I told you to do.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Grabs the poster off the desk, tears it up, and begins hitting her own arm)
